Does not certify all of §8.7, all shading types, or all pattern/transparency combinations.

related_source.rule: Pattern Matrix maps internal pattern coordinates to the default coordinate system of the parent content stream; page-content CTM changes do not re-anchor a page pattern; Form patterns map to the Form default user space at Do; nested patterns map to the outer pattern space.

source.table_index_caveat: Table coverage index records owner/citation and explicitly warns it is not cell-level feature coverage. Existing pattern_forms_current, tiling_pattern_cells_current, and shading_type1_current contain the relevant prior evidence; this shard avoids re-certifying their full scopes.

cells.source: Required: 1 colored (cell stream specifies colors, initialized from parent stream start) or 2 uncolored stencil (cell stream must not set color; prohibited color operators are ignored without error; image masks remain allowed).

Required 1 consistent spacing (processor may adjust cell, steps, matrix within one device pixel), 2 no cell distortion but up-to-one-pixel spacing variation, or 3 constant spacing with additional distortion permitted.
Required pattern-space rectangle; boundaries shall clip the cell. Note says zero width or height still paints one pixel.
Required nonzero signed numbers; may differ from BBox dimensions. Defines the key-cell lattice spacing.
Required dictionary containing all named resources the cell stream needs.
Optional six-number pattern matrix, default identity; translation components may control lattice phase.

features.implementation: Cell parsing, color modes, clip, lattice, parent-stream initial state, and matrix placement are in content/pattern/tiling.rs and pattern/cell.rs.

features.assertion_quality: Prior matrix review found literal painted/gap points for the translated tile; lattice/type tests distinguish periods and include spacing controls. Parent review confirms the negative nonzero-step test (T133) and 35 tiling tests pass. Tile-order equality is not asserted, honoring #428.
features.verdict: Inherited Table 74 feature review is substantive and sufficiently cell-specific for the assigned fields; no duplicate draft. Existing known degenerate-BBox failure B20 remains separately owned. Producer-required Resources and nonzero steps are not converted here into mandatory reader rejection rules.
residuals: Nested Type1 tiling inside a Type1 cell was a coverage opportunity in pattern_forms_current; no failure is established.

ADR 1080's categorical Type1-to-Type2 fallback when snapping is declined remains specifically unconfirmed per tiling_pattern_cells_current parent review; this shard does not resolve that separate lattice policy question.

cells.source: Required shading object, dictionary or stream depending on shading type; its entries are common Table 77 and one of Tables 78–83.
Optional six-number pattern matrix, default identity, as defined in §8.7.2.

Optional graphics-state parameter dictionary effective while the shading pattern is painted. Unspecified eligible parameters are inherited from the graphics state at parent content-stream start, as amended by §11.6.7.

features.source_prose: A shading pattern does not tile. The shading geometry is independent of the path/glyph/mask being painted; pattern matrix maps pattern space to the parent stream's default coordinate space, while the shading object's own matrix/coordinates remain governed by its shading type/target space.
features.implementation: pattern.rs::pattern identifies PatternType 2, reads Table 75 Matrix using shading::matrix_of (identity default), stores the Shading object unresolved for the shading cache, and composes Matrix with Interpreter.base. It builds from pattern_initial augmented with the pattern's own ExtGState. Shading patterns are paints clipped to the consuming mark; tiling logic is not used.
assertions: crates/pdf-model/tests/shadings.rs::a_shading_pattern_fills_only_the_path_it_paints (omitted Matrix identity compared to direct sh)
features.assertion_quality: The existing patterns test checks the default/omitted identity matrix against direct sh at a point. §11.6.7 tests discriminate stream-start versus mark-time and pattern-owned ExtGState values using distinct ICC-calibrated outputs; they exercise the ExtGState cell. Form/annotation and nested-in-tiling controls exercise parent coordinate space with the omitted identity matrix. I found no existing public raster assertion with a nonidentity Table 75 Matrix; the only explicitly translated pattern matrix witness found is for Table 74 tiling, which is a different consumer branch.
features.verdict: The initial public-assertion gap has been closed by parent-added `crates/pdf-model/tests/shading_pattern_matrix_spec_audit.rs::shading_pattern_matrix_maps_pattern_space_before_sampling_its_gradient`; parent reports this test passes. No runtime defect is established.
residuals: No Table 75 Shading-as-stream pattern witness was found in the named PDF model pattern tests. Direct mesh-shading tests consume stream shading objects through `sh`; the Table 75 pattern examples inspected use shading dictionaries. This input-form combination remains unasserted, not an established implementation fault.
Table 75 ExtGState is covered for selected rendering-intent and black-point parameters only; full Table 75/§11.6.7 state semantics remain outside this shard.
